entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ILVerify throws IndexOutOfRangeException when a method ends with a conditional branch or switch #135828
  • JIT: the "Fall thru the end of a method" check in fgLinkBasicBlocks is unreachable for a final conditional branch since #95773 #135825
  • Portable thread pool: Unregister(null) after a one-shot wait fired leaks an AutoResetEvent (Ping.SendPingAsync leaks a handle per ping) #135824
  • JIT: (bug) [Tier0] `ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(r.Ref)` on a null byref no longer throws `NullReferenceException` #135822
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) crash (null deref in `impFixPredLists`) for `finally { while (true) {} }` when profile weights are used #135819
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) OSR patchpoint is not placed for a loop whose backedge-source block has a non-empty IL stack (e.g. `while (i < (flag ? a : b))`), so the loop stays in Tier0 (~100x slower) #135818
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) impImportAndPushBoxForNullable drops GTF_IND_INITCLASS, allowing Nullable<T> loads to be hoisted before static constructor #135817
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) signed `int.Log2(x)` expansion throws before earlier operands are evaluated (wrong exception order, skipped side effect) #135816
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) `OptimizeBools` merges `x < 0 || v.GetElement(x) < 0` and speculates a `GetElement` whose bounds check was removed #135815
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) `int.RotateLeft`/`RotateRight` constant folding creates a non-sign-extended `TYP_INT` constant, so comparisons against it are folded to the wrong result #135814
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) PHI-based jump threading leaves stale VNs on the parents of rewritten PHI uses, so CSE reuses a value from a different SSA def #135813
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) RBO jump threading leaves stale PHI SSA that strength reduction treats as loop-invariant (wrong result) #135812
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) redundant branch opts remove a null check that a non-faulting load depends on (spurious NullReferenceException) #135811
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) `optJumpThreadCore` omits target PHI args for threaded edges, causing `RangeCheck` to unsoundly eliminate bounds checks #135810
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) tuple swap of struct locals with a class-init static struct field reads the new value #135809
    12.0.0
  • Improve Brotli compression of Wasm ReadyToRun runtime-function tables without eager startup reconstruction #135796
  • HighNumberedFd_NotLeakedAfterLoweringRLimit test failing in CI #135795
  • GC: a ≥ 4 GB array allocated during a background GC can contain a stray `0x01` byte (`PREV_EMPTY` left by `make_unused_array`) #135791
    10.0.x
  • OSSupportTest.IOControl_SIOCATMARK_Unix_Success does not wait for the out-of-band byte #135787
    Future
  • [Test Failure] Http1ResponseStreamZeroByteReadTest.ZeroByteRead_BlocksUntilDataIsAvailable on Android x64 CoreCLR #135782
  • Add support for HPKE in COSE #135781
    Future
  • ILVerification: TryGetArgumentValue throws NullReferenceException on results that have no ErrorArguments #135773
  • [mono][aot] AOT compiler output differs between runs with byte-identical inputs even with the deterministic option (differences beyond the AOTID), android-arm64 and android-x64 #135770
  • Linux: HMAC instance creation/disposal regressed 29–33% between .NET 11 preview 4 and RC2 #135759
    Future
  • [API Proposal]: Annotate `MemoryExtensions.Sort` using `TComparer` with `allows ref struct` #135755
  • [browser][coreclr] Integrate R2R debug info flags into WebAssembly SDK #135754
    12.0.0
  • Runtime async has major perf regression since .NET 11 RC2 #135738
  • NATIVE_DLL_SEARCH_DIRECTORIES doesn't support paths containing `:` #135737
  • Test failure: System.Net.NetworkInformation.Tests.PingTest.SendPingWithIPAddress #135736
  • Test failure: System.Net.NetworkInformation.Tests.UnixPingUtilityTests.PacketSizeIsRespected #135735
  • R2R Failed when project contains anonymous types with it's property name with Non-ASCII and same length #135779

Closed

  • Weird behaviour change with global `Mutex` on Linux between .NET 11 rc1 -> rc2 | .NET 10.0.12 -> 10.0.13 #135726
  • ILVerify: conformance target — ECMA-335, CoreCLR behaviour, or both? #135747
  • [ci-scan] Vector3Interop_r crash (SIGSEGV) under GCStress=0xC JitStress=2 (gcstress-extra pipeline) #127827
    11.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) Failed `isinst` to an interface is treated as non-null, folding a GetType() compare and swallowing a NullReferenceException #134193
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) Operand reordering ignores GTF_ORDER_SIDEEFF on the second operand, moving a "proven safe" divide above its proof #134191
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) assert `genActualType(op1) == genActualType(op2)` - range check cloning builds mixed-width (int/long) guard conditions #134459
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) zero-extension of a `lock xadd` result is wrongly elided, so `(uint)Interlocked.Add(ref long, ...)` keeps the upper 32 bits #135385
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) stack-move peephole coalesces two `Volatile.Write`s to an address-exposed local #135386
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) optRemoveRedundantZeroInits removes a required zero store after a catch-handler write #134004
    12.0.0
  • ILVerify throws NullReferenceException on a callvirt to a static method #135771
  • Checked runtime asserts in CallCatchFunclet on Windows x64 with shadow stacks when a thread abort raised at the end of a catch is caught in the same method #135530
  • [Interpreter] Thread abort re-raised at the end of an interpreted catch: Thread::m_OSContext is not set up #135463
  • SslStreamTlsResumeTests.DifferentEncryptionPolicy_NoResume failing #133418
    12.0.0
  • Guidance for unions with data-less cases: `JsonUnionTypeStructuralClassifier` cannot classify them #135742
  • [API Proposal]: System.Collections.Generic.TopologicalSorter #135716
  • Native host crash (EEStartupHelper/GCCoop, coreclr_t::create, breadcrumb_writer_t) on Windows Server 2019 with Server GC enabled, regression in 10.0.12 — minimal repro is a bare console app #135221
  • .NET 8 fails to detect installed ICU on Ubuntu 25.10 (aarch64) #126603
  • [Interpreter] Checked runtime asserts Thread::IsObjRefValid(this) on an interpreted virtual call after CreateCustomAttributeInstance unregisters its GC frame #135535
  • JIT: (bug) [ARM64] non-zeroing `stackalloc` detects SP subtraction wrap with `bvc` (signed overflow), so a huge `stackalloc` silently succeeds instead of overflowing the stack #135524
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) [ARM64] TryLowerCselToCSOp creates GT_SELECT_NEG/INV/INC with a register condition, which LSRA cannot build (wrong code in Release) #134056
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) [ARM64] TryLowerCnsIntCselToCinc keeps the wrong constant as the CINC base and produces an unusable GT_SELECT_INC #134055
    12.0.0
  • ARM64 JIT: `k % 2` reads stale flags after an allocation (`cneg` emitted before its `cmp`), wrong results on .NET 10 #135521
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) [ARM64] `genPutArgStk` gives both LDP destination registers the first field's GC type (bogus/missing GC roots) #134066
    12.0.0
  • Environment variable support for thread pool min threads config #132828
    12.0.0
  • AOT publish on macOS arm64 fails on .NET 11 with xcode-select/xcodebuild error #133476
